name: Cys-loop receptor survey
description: One subunit from each pentameric-LGIC family across the default panel, with sequences fetched. The superfamily is alignable end to end, so this preset feeds the friendliest tier-2 tree in the project — and it carries the AChBP decoy question with it: a search wide enough to find every Cys-loop channel also returns a soluble snail protein that is not one (hazard H2).
